name: devpulse
description: See what's wrong with your dev environment in one call: crashed or conflicting dev servers, log errors, git state and runtime versions.
long_description: devpulse gives Claude a diagnostic snapshot of a local software project: whether the dev server is running, which process holds its port, recent errors from log files with stack traces, git state (branch, uncommitted and conflicted files) and runtime versions, plus a health verdict with a suggested fix. Everything runs locally and secrets are redacted from log output.

tools.name: get_session_snapshot
tools.description: Health verdict with likely cause and fix, framework, git state, dev server ports, recent log errors and runtime versions

tools.name: get_recent_errors
tools.description: ERROR and WARN entries from the project's log files, with stack traces; secrets redacted

tools.name: get_running_services
tools.description: Which dev server ports are listening, the process holding each, and whether it belongs to the project

project_dir.title: Default project folder
project_dir.description: The project devpulse inspects when Claude doesn't name one. You can always ask about a different folder in chat.
